scope: Reviewed deviations of the attachment tooltips, compatibility rules and sight lists from the generated source values (scripts/frosty-attachment-tooltips.py, optic-tooltips.py, frosty-attachment-compatibility.py, frosty-individual-optics.py). Each row names its generator, the entry (weapon, slot, id), the value the files give (sourceValue; null = none) and the value the site keeps (siteValue; null = none). A tooltip row's values are description keys; siteText is the text of a siteValue key the files do not supply. A generator reports each of its rows applied, STALE (the source moved), REDUNDANT (the source now equals the site) or UNUSED (no such entry); the last three fail the run. Kinds: emulated-bug, pending-check, observed, convention.
